title: Lorentz symmetry in self-supervised representation learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) and explicit physical inductive biases have driven major advances in jet tagging, yet they are typically pursued along separate tracks. In this work, we unify both paradigms by integrating the Lorentz-equivariant Geometric Algebra Transformer slim (L-GATr-slim) architecture with the LeJEPA framework for representation learning. Pre-training on 100 million jets from the JetClass dataset, we optimize towards a latent space, which is invariant across physics-motivated jet augmentations. We demonstrate that enforcing Lorentz symmetry in the latent space is critical for representation quality and that this can be achieved either architecturally or learned via kinematic augmentations. translated_title: 自监督表征学习中的洛伦兹对称性
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）与显式物理归纳偏置在喷注标记任务中推动了重大进展，但两者通常沿着各自独立的路线发展。在本工作中，我们通过将洛伦兹等变的几何代数Transformer精简版（L-GATr-slim）架构与LeJEPA表征学习框架相结合，统一了这两种范式。我们在JetClass数据集的1亿个喷注上进行预训练，朝着在物理驱动的喷注增强下保持不变的潜空间进行优化。我们证明，在潜空间中强制实施洛伦兹对称性对表征质量至关重要，且这既可以通过架构设计实现，也可以通过运动学增强学习获得。在使用标准的非不变Transformer骨干网络时，LeJEPA在线性探测和MLP探测准确率上超越了已有的自回归、掩码粒子建模和自蒸馏等基线方法，而L-GATr-slim进一步带来了额外的提升。
tldr: 该论文首次将洛伦兹等变的L-GATr-slim架构与LeJEPA自监督学习框架相统一，证明在潜空间中强制洛伦兹对称性（可通过架构设计或运动学增强学习实现）对喷注标记的表征质量至关重要，并在多项探测准确率上超越了现有基线。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies self-supervised learning and explicit physical inductive biases by integrating the Lorentz-equivariant L-GATr-slim architecture with the LeJEPA framework, demonstrating that enforcing Lorentz symmetry in the latent space—achieved either architecturally or via kinematic augmentations—is critical for representation quality in jet tagging.
